doc: Zone wind (M2-ARC-02; docs/kb/tech/architecture.md, The weather clock). WeatherClock (game/core/weather_clock.gd, a child SceneRouter installs) writes hymn_wind on every scene swap: the zones row whose scene is the new scene, else default. A row is the downwind heading toward_azimuth_deg (clockwise from north = -Z, the convention the water and Haluna rigs use), the speed wind_m_s, and gust 0..1; hymn_wind = (sin(az) * speed, 0, -cos(az) * speed, gust). The clock itself (hymn_wind_time) is never reset. tools/validate_data.py checks every row and that each scene exists. A zone row may carry variants (name -> a wind row) that its own scene applies in place (m2-slice: Haluna's "night", HalunaZone.set_night); validate_data checks them too.

default._note: Any scene without a row, the battle scene included: a moderate onshore breeze, the Drownbell flood rig's breeze direction (boss_vfx.json flood.weather) on the Haluna trade-wind heading.

zones._note: The Haluna trade wind, as the haluna_mood rig sets it (vegetation.md reference 6 m/s).

night._note: B11, the dock at night (HalunaZone.set_night, m2-slice): the trade wind has dropped and the land breeze blows softly out to sea, so the palms barely stir and the sea-glow lies calm.

zones._note: Cutscene B on the shrine steps at sunset (18:05; m2-slice): the trade wind easing toward evening, on the same heading.
The Shell Shrine trial, indoors (m2-slice): near-still air under the fan-shell roof; only the oculus lets a draught in.
